lookDownCutoff.title: Gaze blink cut-off
lookDownCutoff.tooltip: Looking down can make the eye cameras see a blink that didn't happen. Slide right if real blinks get missed when you look down. Slide left if looking down causes false blinks.

skipCooldown.title: Instant back-to-back blinks
skipCooldown.tooltip: Quantum objects can move on every blink, even blinks less than half a second apart. Turn off to use the game's normal half-second wait between moves.

debugLogging.title: Debug logging
debugLogging.tooltip: Log every blink and every quantum move to the mod console.
